# CircuitToHardwareSynthesis

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
Automated or semi-automated synthesis of hardware configurations from formal neural circuit descriptions such as Petri nets. It bridges biological circuit models and neuromorphic implementation, enabling fast prototyping in in-network computing.
